new_claim: If P=(1-eps)P_core+eps H, then the core low-degree advantage is at most [Adv(P,Q)+eps sqrt(E_H kappa_D)]/(1-eps), where kappa_D is the source low-degree Christoffel/leverage function. Therefore the inherited covariance-pressure + smoothed-tail theorem only needs high-degree regularity on a 1-o(1) core, provided eps sqrt(E_H kappa_{D_n})->0.
strict_improvement: On the uniform Boolean cube, kappa_D=sum_{k<=D} binom(N,k). A parity core plus a point-mass contamination of weight eps=1/kappa_D has vanishing degree-D LDA and noised TV ->0, while every fixed-order Renyi divergence of the whole planted law is Theta(N) when D=o(N/log N). Thus whole-law Renyi regularity can fail maximally while the new theorem applies.
mao_boundary: For Mao, Q is uniform and source LDA is exactly zero. Any decomposition with eps sqrt(sum_{k<=D_n}binom(N,k))->0 transfers vanishing LDA to the 1-o(1) core. Since Mao remains strongly distinguishable after fixed noise, no such dominant core can satisfy the inherited smoothed-tail regularity. Mao is therefore not explainable as a vanishing contamination below the low-degree resolution scale.
gaussian_transfer: For standard Gaussian gamma_m, kappa_{m,D}(x)=sum_{1<=|alpha|<=D}He_alpha(x)^2/alpha!. Mehler gives 1+kappa_{m,D}(x)<=rho^{-D}(1-rho^2)^(-m/2)exp(rho||x||^2/(1+rho)), yielding a direct trimming certificate for P08/P09 rare Gaussian bad events.
